turns.patient_opening: Doctor: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on? Patient: I’m a 67-year-old man, and for about two months I’ve had progressively worsening generalized fatigue. My wife also noticed I look paler than usual, and I’ve developed multiple tiny red, nonblanching spots on my extremities.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any involuntary movements recently—like twitching, jerking, shaking, or sudden movements that you can’t control? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No— I haven’t noticed any twitching, jerking, or shaking that I can’t control.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed a **lump in your right breast that doesn’t hurt and feels like it moves a bit when you touch it**? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any lump in my right breast, and I don’t have any painful or movable bump there.”

turns.doctor_question: When you press or gently tap around your belly button area, does it feel tender or painful? (yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, pressing or gently tapping around my belly button doesn’t feel tender or painful.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been vomiting recently (yes or no)?
Have you noticed a lump or mass in your **right breast** (for example, a new or growing area you can feel)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any lump or mass in my right breast—nothing new or growing that I can feel.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed that the lenses in **both** of your eyes look **cloudy or hazy**, like you’re seeing through a film or mist? (Yes/No)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed that the lenses in either of my eyes look cloudy or hazy.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any **unintentional weight loss** recently—meaning you’ve lost weight **without trying** (for example, over the past few months)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any unintentional weight loss.” “I’ve mainly just felt progressively more fatigued, and my wife says I look paler.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed a **lump or mass in your right breast that doesn’t hurt** (painless), even if it’s small?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any lump or painless mass in my right breast, even if it’s small.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been pregnant recently, or is there any chance you could be pregnant right now?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t been pregnant, and there’s no chance of that.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed a breast lump or swelling that seems to move or shift when you touch it (rather than staying fixed in one spot)?
turns.patient_answer: “No—I haven’t noticed any breast lump or swelling that moves or shifts when I touch it.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you find yourself avoiding using your right knee because it hurts? (yes/no)
turns.patient_answer: “No—I haven’t been avoiding using my right knee because it hurts. My main issue is the progressively worsening fatigue, along with looking paler and having those tiny non-blanching red spots on my extremities.”
